run_train_calm_model: run the CALM model training script with absl flags for anchor and aug model paths
train_CALM: train a CALM model using Hugging Face Trainer on the wikitext dataset with configurable hyperparameters
configure_training_args: configure TrainingArguments with epochs, batch size, learning rate, and eval steps for CALM training
preprocess_wikitext: preprocess wikitext dataset examples by tokenizing text with truncation and padding to max length 512
create_calm_config: create a CALMConfig with anchor model, aug model, number of connections, and number of heads
